title: Bot Portal MVP - Agent Management & A2A Message Router
description: Build a web portal to manage multiple zeroclaw AI agents running as Docker containers. Portal serves as A2A message router with channels (agent1::agent2, general), message logging, and agent configuration. Go backend + React frontend + SQLite.

title: Project scaffolding: Go module, directory structure, Makefile, docker-compose
description: Initialize Go module, create directory structure per ADR-001, set up Makefile with build/run/test targets, create docker-compose.yml for dev environment.

title: Data models & SQLite storage layer
description: Define Agent (with cached AgentCard), Channel, TaskLog domain models. Implement SQLite store with migrations. CRUD for agents, channels, task logs. TaskLog stores full task lifecycle (status, messages, artifacts) per channel.

title: Docker container lifecycle manager
description: Implement Docker Engine API integration using Go SDK. Support create/start/stop/restart/remove containers. Each agent container gets AGENT_ID, PORTAL_URL, PORTAL_BEARER_TOKEN env vars. Mount config.toml with A2A config (agent_card, peers, skills). Stream container logs. Expose port 9000 per container.

title: REST API for agent and channel management
description: Implement REST endpoints: agent CRUD, start/stop/restart, channel listing, message history. Use chi or stdlib mux. Include SSE endpoint for real-time message streaming.

title: A2A message router: client + server + channel routing
description: Core feature. Implement Google A2A standard integration. Portal acts as A2A server: POST /tasks (receive tasks from agents), GET /tasks/{id} (task status), GET /tasks/{id}/stream (SSE TaskUpdate stream), POST /tasks/{id}/cancel. Portal acts as A2A client: POST /tasks to forward to target agents, GET /tasks/{id}/stream to subscribe to agent updates. Serve AgentCard at /.well-known/agent.json. Route by channel: agent1::agent2 for direct, general for broadcast. Bearer token auth. Log all Tasks and TaskMessages.

title: A2A protocol types (Google A2A standard)
description: Define Go types matching zeroclaw's Google A2A implementation: AgentCard (name, description, version, capabilities, authentication, endpoints, skills), Task (id, status, created_at, updated_at, messages, artifacts), TaskMessage (role: user|agent, content, timestamp), TaskUpdate (task_id, status, message, artifact), Artifact (id, type, name, content), CreateTaskRequest/Response. Also A2APeer and A2AConfig for peer management.

title: React frontend: dashboard, agent management, message viewer
description: Set up React+TypeScript+Vite. Build pages: Dashboard (agent overview), Agent Detail (config editor, logs), Message Viewer (real-time A2A message log with channel filter), Channel View. Use SSE for real-time updates.

title: Integration testing with mock agents
description: Create a simple mock agent Docker image for testing. Write integration tests for: agent registration, A2A message routing, channel creation, message logging. Test direct and broadcast channels.
